priorityList: Cast Kill Shot whenever available via Hunter's Prey procs or when targets are below 20% health.
Cast Butchery if you are at 3 charges to prevent capping.
Cast Fury of the Eagle if you have 3 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if Mad Bombardier is active.
Cast Butchery to consume Merciless Blow procs or apply Internal Bleeding.
Cast Flanking Strike if you need Focus and it is available.
Cast Kill Command to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks, ensuring you do not overcap either.
